pois.name: Rick's Cafe
pois.intro: Rick's Café Casablanca is a restaurant, bar and café located in the city of Casablanca, Morocco. Opened March 1, 2004, the place was designed to recreate in reality the set of the bar made famous by Humphrey Bogart and Ingrid Bergman in the movie classic Casablanca.

pois.name: Musée du Judaïsme marocain متحف التراث اليهودي المغربي
pois.intro: The Museum of Moroccan Judaism is a museum of Jewish life in Morocco in Casablanca, Morocco. Established in 1997, it is the only museum devoted to Judaism in the Arab world.

pois.name: Twin Center
pois.intro: The Casablanca Twin Center is a complex of two skyscrapers located at Casablanca, Morocco. The two structures, the West Tower and the East Tower, have 28 floors each.

pois.name: Place des Nations Unies ساحة الأمم المتحدة
pois.intro: United Nations Square is a public square in the center of Casablanca, Morocco. It has been central in the history of Casablanca.

pois.name: Phare d'El Hank منارة العنق
pois.intro: The El Hank lighthouse is a lighthouse located on the tip of El Hank, west of the port of Casablanca. It is managed by the Port and Maritime Authority within the Ministry of Equipment, Transport, Logistics and Water.

pois.name: Dar Khalifa دار خليفة
pois.intro: Dar Khalifa, or The Caliph's House, is a large, historical landmark and private home in walled grounds. It is located in Ain Diab, an affluent suburb of Casablanca that was also host to a sprawling shanty town until the area was redeveloped.
